description: Create or update tax rates by name (max 100 per call, case-insensitive match) — the direct fix for the 'tenant has no tax rate configured' blocker on item creation. percentage (0-100) is required when creating; updates are preserve-on-omit. isDefault=true moves the default flag (exactly one live rate stays default). validateOnly=true dry-runs every row. Partial success with per-row errors; resubmitting converges. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential — tax rates are tenant-wide settings.

taxRates.description: Tax-rate rows to create/update (max 100). name is required per row.

isDefault.description: true makes this the tenant's default rate (clears the flag on every other rate).

name.description: Tax rate name — the upsert identity (case-insensitive). Required.

percentage.description: Percentage, 0-100. Required when creating; preserve-on-omit on update.

validateOnly.description: true = dry-run: validate + probe every row and report the would-be action per row, writing nothing.

name: upsert_tax_rates
title: Upsert Tax Rates
